source_findings.causal_interleaving: Pause real rotation_confirmed protected Sync. Consume /exit through the real terminal callback (or eligible public api.Pause sends it), then release actual Sync. handleControl sets intentional and retires epoch, but the confirmation branch immediately returns Cursor rotation confirmation retired instead of reaching intentional termination publication. Owned runtime is confirmed dead; durable row remains waiting on old committed identity and public pause times out after its unchanged 5-second allowance. No held bytes were emitted.
source_findings.repair_request: Honor consumed intentional exit while retiring confirmation: terminate owned runtime and finalize using authoritative committed identity/history, preserving original cancellation deadline, independent verification and truthful persistence-error behavior. Do not convert the source failure into timeout relaxation or false ended.

source_findings.causal_interleaving: After actual fresh publication, fail real protected Sync for promoted submission_accepted. The controller has removed the entry from held and inserted it into queue before successful persistence. Failure cleanup prints individual refusals only for held/pending provisional entries, then returns early for persistenceFailed, so this observed held submission has no per-ID visible refusal or cancellation. Pane ends after provisional/published notices. Raw ACP has zero bytes for the input; committed new session and required history truthfully remain.
source_findings.repair_request: Retain each provisional disposition owner through durable admission and visibly refuse/cancel every known unstarted promoted entry on persistence failure, without relying on a broken recorder, replay, fabricated end, or rollback of committed publication. Test accepts either explicit per-ID held refusal or cancellation-before-dispatch.

source_findings.causal_interleaving: After fresh publication, replay a known outgoing session update/child callback and known retired permission/plan callbacks (including same plan tool under a new callback ID). Product safely gives them no current authority, but protected retired_event and retired_authorization records use tr.binding.SessionID=fresh session at the top level. Outgoing events are therefore falsely attributed to the new conversation; retired_event data carries old session while retired_authorization lacks old session attribution.
source_findings.repair_request: Preserve authoritative originating conversation in each retired-event/authorization protected record using existing known session/request/tool identity, without granting authority or inventing origin. Keep retirement tracking bounded. Evaluate corresponding retired-response attribution, but current causal regressions specifically pin known old session events and permission/plan callbacks.
